topics.reference_answer: Mamba introduced input-dependent selective state spaces as a linear-time alternative to attention for sequence modeling. [arxiv:2312.00752] Empirical work nevertheless reports limitations in long-context comprehension and in-context retrieval, motivating retrieval-enhanced and hybrid variants. [arxiv:2408.15496] [arxiv:2410.18572] Samba and Jamba combine state-space and attention or Transformer components to preserve efficiency while extending language-model capacity. [arxiv:2406.07522] [arxiv:2403.19887] RAMba adds hardware-aligned hierarchical sparse attention to provide random access over contexts far beyond its pretraining length. [arxiv:2504.16795] Motif-Mamba augments diagonal Mamba transitions with motif-constrained low-rank recurrent interactions while retaining linear-time recurrence. [arxiv:2608.00027] Hierarchical Memory Mamba targets the fixed-capacity recurrent-state bottleneck with working and persistent memory, reporting improved retrieval and reasoning with small parameter overhead. [arxiv:2608.02347] Harmonic provides a recent hierarchical SSM comparator whose long-context results help test whether improvements are specific to Mamba variants or to hierarchical recurrence more broadly. [arxiv:2606.24650]
